title: Hegseth hails Iran 'victory' as confusion remains over ceasefire deal
summary: US ​Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Wednesday ​that the United States has had a decisive military victory over Iran and that Tehran's missile ​program ‌has been functionally destroyed a day after the two countries agreed a two-week ceasefire to hold talks on ending the war.
